units.source_text: 老师把我一个人叫过屋里，当着母亲的面说了这孩子干得不错之类的话。

en.t: The teacher called me into the room alone, and in front of my mother said something to the effect that this child had done well.

units.source_text: 我低下头来，几乎没有着母亲的脸一眼。

en.t: I lowered my head and hardly looked at my mother's face even once.

units.source_text: 我瞥见她穿着褪色的藏青棉布劳动裤的膝以及放在膝上的龌龊的手。

en.t: I caught a glimpse of the knees of her faded navy cotton work trousers, and of her filthy hands resting on her knees.
